content_sections.heading: HPCL Turnaround Consultant Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 24 vacancies have been notified for engagement as Turnaround Consultant at HPCL Visakh Refinery, distributed across roles and HPCL salary grades as follows: The Salary Grade 10F and 10G vacancies (1 post each) fall under the Senior Grade F/G - Technical Advisor/Turnaround Mentor category, intended for experienced refinery professionals who can provide technical leadership and mentoring for critical turnaround activities, particularly in Static Maintenance.

content_sections.heading: HPCL Turnaround Consultant Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Retired employees of HPCL or other Public Sector Oil Companies having relevant experience for the position applied for are eligible to apply. The applicant shall not be more than 64 years of age as on 31.07.2026. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility. Applicants must have worked in the relevant department/division in the Refinery Maintenance or Operations Department (as per the position applied for) and should have a minimum of 5 years of experience. Preference will be given to candidates having substantial hands-on experience in major Refinery Shutdowns/Turnarounds (TA), including planning, execution, field coordination, contractor management and safe completion of turnaround jobs. A minimum cooling period of 2 months is required between retirement and re-engagement. The applicant shall have no major penalty awarded during the service period and no minor penalty awarded during the last 10 years of service period. The notification does not specify a fixed minimum educational qualification; it requires relevant department experience as per the role applied for. The application form (Annexure II) requires candidates to furnish details of their Graduation and Post-Graduation qualifications.

rows.required_experience: Worked in Maintenance Department - Static Division

content_sections.heading: HPCL Turnaround Consultant Salary and Compensation
content_sections.text: The monthly fee will not exceed the applicant's last drawn salary (Basic + DA), after adjusting the notional monthly payment arising out of Annuity (without commutation), based on the option of "15 years certain & life thereafter." In addition, reimbursement of conveyance expenses and monthly mobile expenses will be provided as per the Guidelines for Engaging Ex-Employees. No other allowances or benefits will be extended. TDS, as applicable, will be deducted as per taxation rules. Selected consultants will work in General Shift or Rotational Shift (8-hour or 12-hour schedule) as advised by the Turnaround In-Charge.

content_sections.heading: HPCL Turnaround Consultant Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on Personal Interaction/Interview of shortlisted candidates by a Selection Committee. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email about the date and time of the interaction/interview. Candidates are advised to mention a valid email ID and mobile number in their application. The interview may be conducted online (via Zoom) or in physical mode; shortlisted candidates will be informed accordingly by email. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the selection process if the interview is conducted physically. No reimbursement will be provided for joining. The consultant appointment will be in the form of a contract with a specific termination clause. No other facilities, benefits, allowances, or compensation would be permissible except those specifically mentioned in the contract. Ex-employees will be required to abide by the Confidentiality Clause applicable to regular employees. The engagement period is 3 months, subject to the applicant not attaining 65 years of age during the engagement period and subject to medical fitness. The contract may be terminated prematurely by giving 30 days' notice from either side.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents
content_sections.text: The following documents must be attached along with the application: Copy of Service Certificate issued by Employer (PSU) showing last drawn Basic Salary Copy of Aadhar Card Work Experience Certificate issued by Employer mentioning the Job Roles Self-Declaration as per format (Annexure III) towards no major penalty during service period and no minor penalty during the last 10 years of service period (applicable for candidates other than HPCL ex-employees) Copy of Annuity Certificate (SBFS/NPS) Note: Upon selection, candidates other than HPCL retired employees will have to submit a certificate from their respective employers as per the format in Annexure IV.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HPCL Turnaround Consultant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download and fill the application as per the format given in Annexure II. Attach all required supporting documents (scanned PDF copies) as listed above. Combine the application and all supporting documents into a single PDF file. Ensure the application is neatly typed and not handwritten. Send the single PDF to the email ID: [email protected] Mention the Subject of the Email as: "Application for Turnaround Consultant at VR" Ensure the application reaches on or before the last date, 12 September 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is HPCL Visakh Refinery Turnaround Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an engagement drive by HPCL Visakh Refinery to appoint superannuated employees of public sector oil and gas companies as Turnaround Consultants on a short-term contract basis, to support the major Block Turnaround scheduled for November–December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 24 vacancies are notified across roles such as Maintenance Static, Operations, Instrumentation, Electrical, Rotary, Civil, and Senior Grade F/G Technical Advisor/Turnaround Mentor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 12 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Retired employees of HPCL or other Public Sector Oil Companies with relevant experience for the position applied for, and a minimum of 5 years of experience in the relevant department, are eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The applicant shall not be more than 64 years of age as on 31.07.2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: There is no online application portal mentioned; candidates must email their filled application (Annexure II) along with supporting documents as a single PDF to [email protected] on or before 12 September 2026.
